questions.subject: Kannada Literature
questions.question: What is Kannada literature?

options.A: The body of oral and written creative, devotional, philosophical, dramatic and scholarly works composed in the Kannada language.
options.B: Only the poetry composed in the Kannada language during the Vijayanagara period.
options.C: The body of religious texts written in Sanskrit and translated into Kannada.
options.D: Only modern prose works written in Kannada after the 19th century.

questions.explanation: Kannada literature is the body of oral and written creative, devotional, philosophical, dramatic and scholarly works composed in the Kannada language.

questions.subject: Kannada Literature
questions.question: What is the earliest available major literary work in Kannada?
questions.explanation: Kavirajamarga is generally dated to the 9th century CE (around 850 CE) and is the earliest available major literary work in Kannada.

questions.subject: Kannada Literature
questions.question: Who is traditionally associated with the composition of Kavirajamarga?
questions.explanation: Rashtrakuta king Nripatunga Amoghavarsha I is traditionally associated with Kavirajamarga; the work also refers to the poet Srivijaya, and the precise authorship has been discussed by scholars.

questions.subject: Kannada Literature
questions.question: What is the importance of Kavirajamarga?

options.A: It is the first Kannada translation of the Mahabharata.
options.B: It is an early work on poetics and literary criticism and gives evidence of Kannada literary conventions, poets, styles and the geographical spread of Kannada.
options.C: It is a collection of Jain religious and moral narratives.
options.D: It is a Vachana anthology compiled by Basavanna.

questions.explanation: Kavirajamarga is an early work on poetics and literary criticism and gives evidence of Kannada literary conventions, poets, styles and the geographical spread of Kannada.

questions.subject: Kannada Literature
questions.question: What is generally regarded as the earliest extant Kannada prose work?
questions.explanation: Vaddaradhane, attributed to Shivakotiacharya and generally dated to around the 9th century, is regarded as the earliest extant Kannada prose work.

questions.subject: Kannada Literature
questions.question: What is Vaddaradhane about?

options.A: It is a collection of Jain religious and moral narratives, traditionally described as containing 19 stories.
options.B: It narrates the life of the first Jain Tirthankara, Rishabhanatha.
options.C: It presents the mace duel between Bhima and Duryodhana.
options.D: It is a Kannada retelling of the Ramayana.

questions.explanation: Vaddaradhane is a collection of Jain religious and moral narratives, traditionally described as containing 19 stories.

questions.subject: Kannada Literature

questions.subject: Kannada Literature
